answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tundra of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ledge of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
